tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: Figma «Brand colors/Primary». Deepest brand blue: selected checkbox/radio/switch fills, active pagination page, top navigation bar, page titles and breadcrumbs. Text in bg-main on it 10.9:1.

tokens.name: brand-secondary
tokens.usage: Figma «Brand colors/Secondry» (documented as Dark #0A5083). Active tab fill (Tabs style 1), active stepper circle and step title, selected choice-card text and border. Text in bg-main on it 8.4:1.

tokens.name: brand-default
tokens.usage: Figma «Brand colors/default» (documented as Secondary #1668A4). Primary button fill, completed stepper steps. Text in bg-main on it 5.9:1.

tokens.name: brand-light
tokens.usage: Figma «Brand colors/light» (documented as Primary #3088C8 — text and button background). Primary-button hover, secondary/tertiary button text and border, active Tabs style 3. Only 3.8:1 with white and on white: large or bold 24px+ text only — the file uses it at 18px bold, which misses AA.

tokens.name: brand-shade-20
tokens.usage: Figma «Brand colors/Shades/Primary 20» (documented Primary 5). Faintest brand tint: side-menu hover background.

tokens.name: brand-shade-30
tokens.usage: Figma «Brand colors/Shades/Primary 30» (documented Primary 10). Selected choice-card background, active stepper step, selected side-menu item.

tokens.name: brand-shade-40
tokens.usage: Figma «Brand colors/Shades/Primary 40» (documented Primary 20). Hover background of Tabs style 1.

tokens.name: brand-shade-50
tokens.usage: Figma «Brand colors/Shades/Primary 50» (documented Primary 50). Border of the active stepper step.

tokens.name: bg-main
tokens.usage: Figma «Stander colors/BG/BG-Main». Page background and the main surface (40% of the 60-30-10 neutral share); also white text on brand fills.

tokens.name: bg-element
tokens.usage: Figma «Stander colors/BG/BG-Element». Cards, inputs and other raised elements on bg-main.

tokens.name: bg-soft
tokens.usage: Figma «Stander colors/BG/BG-Soft» (Soft Background). Service sub-card background, inactive stepper number circle.

tokens.name: bg-light-grey
tokens.usage: Figma «Stander colors/BG/BG\LightGrey» (Light Grey Background). Table header, dashboard card background, stepper action line, default status badge.

tokens.name: grey-soft
tokens.usage: Figma «Stander colors/Grey Scale/Soft Gray». Disabled button/checkbox fill, cancel-button border, dividers, dialog border.

tokens.name: grey-dark
tokens.usage: Figma «Stander colors/Grey Scale/Dark Gray». Unchecked checkbox/radio/switch border, disabled button border. 1.6:1 on white — below the 3:1 control-border floor.

tokens.name: font-primary
tokens.usage: Figma «Stander colors/Fonts/Primary-Font». Main text and icons on bg-main, bg-element, bg-soft and every status background (7.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: font-secondary
tokens.usage: Figma «Stander colors/Fonts/Secondary-Font». Helper text under fields. 2.9:1 on white — misses AA 4.5:1; keep it to non-essential hints or use font-primary.

tokens.name: font-secondary-dark
tokens.usage: Figma «Neutral/Font Color/Secondary Dark». Field labels inside data cards (key-data rows, info lists) and quarter labels. 4.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: font-tertiary
tokens.usage: Figma «Stander colors/Fonts/Tertiary-Font». Placeholders, input borders, disabled text. 2.0:1 on white — decorative only, never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: status-default
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Defualt/Default Status». Dot of the neutral status badge; calendar marks.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Informative/Informative». Informative icon stroke and title text. 3.6:1 on white: icons and 24px+ text.

tokens.name: info-stroke
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Informative/Stroke-Informative». Border of informative alerts and status badges.

tokens.name: info-icon-bg
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Informative/BG-Icon-Informative». Circle behind informative icons.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Informative/BG-Informative». Informative alert, toast and badge background.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Success/Success». Success icon, dot and alert title. 3.1:1 on white, 2.8:1 on success-bg: icons and dots, not body text.

tokens.name: success-stroke
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Success/Stroke-Success». Border of success alerts and toasts.

tokens.name: success-icon-bg
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Success/BG-Icon-Success». Circle behind success icons.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Success/BG-Success». Success alert, toast and badge background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Warning/Warning». Warning icon and dot. 1.7:1 on white — never as text; pair with font-primary copy.

tokens.name: warning-stroke
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Warning/Stroke-Warning». Border of warning alerts and toasts.

tokens.name: warning-icon-bg
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Warning/BG-Icon-Warning». Circle behind warning icons.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Warning/BG-Warning». Warning alert, toast and badge background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Danger/Danger». Error borders, error labels and helper text, destructive buttons, danger icons. 5.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: danger-stroke
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Danger/Stroke-Danger». Border of danger alerts and toasts.

tokens.name: danger-icon-bg
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Danger/BG-Icon-Danger». Circle behind danger icons.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Figma «Status/Danger/BG-Danger». Danger alert, toast and badge background. danger text on it 4.9:1.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Figma «Heading/H5/Bold». Page titles in the navbar (there at 24/32).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Figma «Body/Medium/Button Bold». Desktop buttons, active tabs; input values use it at weight 400.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Figma «Body/Default/Regural». Default body copy, helper text, toast text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Label-to-icon gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Small-button and mobile-button padding and gap; choice-card gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The most used step: desktop button padding and gap, label→field→helper gap, input vertical padding, alert padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, tab padding, dialog sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Inline dialog padding, alert content gap, navbar block padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Popup padding and section gap; page side gutters in the navbar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, choice cards, tabs, status badges, alerts, toasts, pagination buttons.

tokens.name: radius-button-sm
tokens.usage: Small (32px) buttons; checkbox corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons (44px and 36px), popups.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switch tracks, radio buttons, icon circles, stepper numbers.

tokens.name: shadow-s
tokens.usage: Figma «S - Shadow». Alerts, toasts, pagination buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-m
tokens.usage: Figma «M - Shadow». Focused input, popups.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: Figma «Drop Shadow 1». Navbar bottom edge.
